title: NoticeCancelledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'notice.cancelled'. ALL-USER broadcast, same posture as notice.published — deliberately NOT admin-only (STATE.md "Admin broadcast notifications — system notices", N2/NG1). Emitted ONLY by an explicit admin cancel (POST /system/notices/{id}/cancel via packages/db/src/query/notices.ts's cancelNoticeAndEmit) — a notice superseded by a later publish does NOT emit this (NG8). The acting admin is recorded only at the envelope's own actorUserId, never in this payload.
